name: censorship-event-database
description: A denominator-aware, cross-layer, longitudinal (2007-2026) event corpus of crypto-stack censorship. Each record is an event: a legal/state/corporate trigger together with its observed per-layer reactions across six layers (L0 network, L1 consensus, L3 RPC, L4 frontend, asset_onchain, off-ramp CEX). Unmeasured event x layer cells are recorded as observability gaps, never as zeros; conditional rates are reported only against a public evidence denominator. The release surface is all 405 event YAML records; the paper analysis corpus is the 365 admitted events.
citeAs: Yang, Xiangwen. (2026). Cross-Layer Censorship Event Database (version 0.2.0-rc-dryrun-11). https://github.com/chnyangs/censorship-event-database. See CITATION.cff for canonical BibTeX / APA / DOI.
personalSensitiveInformation: Records describe public enforcement events (sanctions designations, delistings, takedowns) and cite publicly documented wallet addresses already named in OFAC SDN or court records; no private personal data is introduced.

distribution.name: repo
distribution.description: The dataset repository (events, schema, codebook, derived artifacts, and paper tables).

distribution.name: event-records
distribution.description: One YAML file per event (405 records), validated against schema/event.schema.json (schema_version 0.2.0).

distribution.name: event-schema
distribution.description: JSON Schema for an event record.

distribution.name: codebook
distribution.description: Coding rules for fuzzy edges (attribution, coverage status, admission tier, evidence tier). Version 4.1.0.

recordSet.name: events
recordSet.description: Censorship events. 405 total records; 365 admitted (status=admitted) form the paper analysis corpus; 30 draft and 10 rejected are released for transparency. Strata: S1 OFAC SDN (55), S2 OFAC removal (1), S3 DOJ/SEC/CFTC/FIOD (90), S4 nation-state (122), S5 corporate (107), S6 supranational (30).

field.name: status
field.description: admitted | draft | rejected. Admitted (365) is the paper corpus.

field.name: evidence_tier
field.description: Source-strength grade orthogonal to admission_tier; absent = admission_grade, else attested_secondary.

field.name: trigger
field.description: The legal/state/corporate action that initiates the event (type, date, actor, citation).

field.name: target
field.description: The platform/asset/user the trigger acts upon.

field.name: coverage
field.description: Per-layer coverage status: measured | partially_measured | not_measured | not_applicable.

field.name: observations
field.description: Per-layer observations: layer, observation_kind (observed_change | observed_no_change), attribution (direct | plausible | unknown | none), sources/anchors.

field.name: scoped_claim
field.description: One-sentence narrow empirical claim the event supports.
